title: Database Leaks
html:
Database leaks

Data Breach Search Engines

For API access and service-specific caveats when searching breach or reputation data, see the Reconnaissance and Threat-Intelligence APIs catalog.

  • GreyNoise Visualizer - Look up IPs and CIDRs, and query scanner activity by tags, CVEs, and metadata.[1]
  • DeHashed - Search exposed data by usernames, email addresses, IP addresses, and other selectors; monitoring and an API are also available.[2]
  • Have I Been Pwned? - Check whether an email address appears in known data breaches or paste records; notifications and an API are also available.[3]
  • ScamSearch - Search reported scammer records by profile picture, email, username, phone number, crypto address, or website.[4]
  • Intelligence X - Search selectors such as email addresses, domains, URLs, IPs, and CIDRs across indexed sources.[5]
  • SpyCloud - Check a business email or domain for exposed credentials, infostealer-infected identities, and stolen session cookies.[6]
  • WeLeakInfo - Search leaked databases using domains, names, emails, IDs, phones, IPs, URLs, or hashes.[7]
  • BreachDirectory - Check if your email or username was compromised.
  • LeakCheck - Search for exposed email, username, phone, hash, or domain data and monitor for new entries.[8]
  • Findemail.io - Find email addresses for a given company.
  • Library of Leaks - Search public documents, companies, and people, including leak datasets.[9]
  • LeakRadar - Search leaked credentials by email, domain, or raw string and monitor for new exposures.[10]
  • InfoStealers - Search infostealer logs from infected devices and monitor new data.[11]
  • Leak-Lookup - Search across data breaches and monitor credential exposure.[12]
  • Scylla.so - Community-driven database breach search engine.
  • Leaked.domains - Search leaked credentials and related records by domain, email, username, password, IP, and other selectors.[13]
  • WhiteIntel - Monitor dark-web activity, credential leaks, infostealer data, and brand mentions.[14]
  • PSBDMP - Pastebin dump search and monitoring platform.

Tools to enumerate data leaks

  • Leaker - Passive leak discovery CLI that searches multiple online sources by email, username, domain, keyword, or phone.[15]
